independence.basis: Actual original RGBA source, stored skin/hair/reference masks and v4 tint inspected at native size and magnified; coordinates checked against the PNG masks. Frozen source reports hashed only for provenance; their intended regions did not decide semantic judgments.

scope.generalization: Sample findings only; no claim for the other 300 frames or all looks.

interpretation: No prop/clothing contamination is allowed by the goal; 16 independently observed failures reject this immutable candidate sample.
PASS for contamination means no spill observed in the inspected PNG views, not owner approval or a proof of all-mask semantic perfection.
Unmasked exposed skin is recorded separately. The formal >=60% face/forearm rule applies only to idle S; the review does not invent a 100% coverage requirement for all other poses.
Source hair reference must include actual hair and its ink, not face, collar or tools. A numeric >=50% is only a diagnostic until reference semantics are independently certified.
Alpha and supplied-outline preservation are mechanical properties and do not repair semantic contamination, unmasked limbs or hair-reference validity.
The immutable v1 failure record must remain available if a later revision is repaired; this report does not assess that later revision.
source_envelope_hash_limitation: Per-envelope digests copied from immutable audit40; exact source-report file bytes were rehashed and matched. No claim of independently reconstructing the envelope serialization.
